status_scope: Postprocessing source review, not verification of completed result artifacts
scope: Postprocessing source review and pure-function reference checks; no training or remote operations

methodology.sparse_five_fold_pooling: PASS: pool scores and IDs across five folds before balanced accuracy, separately for each share/m/repeat
methodology.paired_prompt_bootstrap: PASS: same resampled prompt indices for candidate and baseline; class recall denominators follow the resampled prompts; conditional on fitted models and development folds

resolved_findings.title: Validate each sparse score block against its IDs and label count
resolved_findings.resolution: Resolved: score shape and true-vector shape checked; labels compared against authoritative sample IDs. Current lines 70-72.
resolved_findings.detail: Only score finiteness is checked. A block with the wrong number of rows or columns can enter the pooled score matrix; compensating row-count errors across folds can silently misalign scores and truths, while a 17-column block silently omits a class.
resolved_findings.required_change: Before pooling, assert scores.ndim == 2 and scores.shape == (len(current), len(labels)); assert true.shape == (len(current),) and integer labels are in range.

resolved_findings.title: Derive or verify fold stability metrics from validated predictions
resolved_findings.resolution: Resolved: all 15 fold metrics recomputed from checked score blocks, CSV keys and values validated, and recomputed values used for paired stability. Current lines 50-56 and 89-95.
resolved_findings.detail: fold_metrics.csv is trusted without verifying unique complete (fold, share) keys or checking its BA values. Missing, duplicate, stale, or changed records can produce misleading positive/negative fold counts and deltas while verified.json still reports PASS; missing entries can also emit NaN.
resolved_findings.required_change: Recompute per-fold BA from the already validated OOF scores, or require all 15 unique expected keys and finite BA values equal to recomputed scores; reject non-finite final values.

limitations: Full verify_results.py was not executed because completed result artifacts were not supplied for this review.
The running Kaggle kernel and remote state were not queried.
Only matrix_counts and deterministic sampling/reference calculations were executed; no classifier, vectorizer fitting, or model inference was run.
